_about: Wild things to pick (Forage, scripts/items/forage.gd; README.md, Forage). DESIGN: fixed spots per area, what grows there changes with the season, and a picked spot grows again after one night. items: per id (the item is wild:<id>) a name, sell (G in the shipping bin; thrown in or held out like a crop) and look (the placeholder icon: shape shoot, fern, bud, berries, pod, nut or mushroom; color, accent). Some are eaten raw (data/foods.json raw, keyed wild:<id>). spots: per map id a list of {cell [x, y], spring?, summer?, fall?, winter?: an item id}; a season left out has nothing there. E on a spot with free hands lifts it overhead (with the hands full it goes in the rucksack, if there is room). Balance (ours): a full round of the bamboo hill is about 200 G a day in spring and summer, 275 in fall (one matsutake spot), 75 in winter; the walk from the farm up and back is the cost (no stamina). Early on that is about a turnip bag's harvest a day, later a small share of the farm's income. See WORKLOG 2026-11-01 Forage.
